# Angie Hu — angiehu.com

> Personal site of Angie Hu (胡珮甄): Taipei-based art & IP licensing agency founder (Hu Creates), former Disney / Zynga senior concept designer, and builder of practical AI tools. Site is in Traditional Chinese with an English version (language toggle, top right).

## Who is Angie Hu

- Graduate of Art Center College of Design (Los Angeles)
- Former Senior Concept Designer at Disney and Zynga
- Founder of Hu Creates Co., Ltd. (胡創有限公司), a professional art & IP licensing agency in Taipei: https://www.hucreates.com
- Represents IPs incl. Alexander the Fat Tiger (Bu2ma), Mr. Shark (鯊魚先生), Sharkitty, Annoying Birds
- Consultant for Gamania, WANIN International, ASUS, Cayenne Entertainment, Moonshine Animation, 好奇心創意

## AI Tools (built by Angie)

- [塔羅占卜 AI Tarot Reading](https://angiehu.com/tools/tarot/): AI tarot reading web app, multiple spreads, bilingual (zh/en). Live at https://tarot.angiehu.com
- [旅遊花費統計 Travel Expense Tracker](https://angiehu.com/tools/travel-expense/): scan receipts / credit-card screenshots, AI extracts amounts, converts currency at the day's bank rate. Public version in development (not yet open).
- [Pantone 色票轉換器 Pantone Color Converter](https://angiehu.com/tools/pantone-converter/): free web-based Pantone ↔ HEX / RGB / CMYK converter — a lightweight alternative for designers after Pantone libraries were removed from Photoshop / Adobe apps (no plug-in install needed). Free to use at https://color.hucreates.com (a paid unlock tier is still in development).
- [名片掃描器 Card Scanner](https://angiehu.com/tools/card-scanner/): AI business card scanner — photograph or upload cards (several per photo, front/back auto-paired), AI extracts name/company/title/phone/email/address, review and tag for follow-up, export to Excel / Google Sheets / vCard / CSV. Card photos are not stored; no account needed. Free (10 cards/day) at https://scan.hucreates.com; Pro US$5/month (200 cards/day, 20 photos per scan, cross-device list sync, duplicate detection, Excel summary sheet, custom fields).
- [收據掃描報帳 Receipt Scanner](https://angiehu.com/tools/receipt-scanner/): AI receipt scanner for expense reports — reads amounts, currency, and invoice numbers, auto-crops receipts, flags duplicates. Internal tool (public version in development).
- [Ink Match 印刷特別色比對](https://angiehu.com/tools/ink-match/): Photoshop plugin — reads your foreground color and lists the closest spot/special print inks (Coated/Uncoated, ΔE2000), one-click add to swatches. In development (third-party paid plugin).
- [LINE 貼圖工廠 Sticker Factory](https://angiehu.com/tools/line-sticker-factory/): one-stop sticker & image tool — validate/fix/pack LINE stickers for Creators Market, build WhatsApp and Telegram sticker packs, animated stickers processed frame by frame (GIF → APNG), on-device AI background removal with manual touch-up tools, plus general image utilities (crop, resize, format convert). Images are processed in the browser and never sent to AI services or used for training. Free to use at https://sticker.hucreates.com (paid unlock tier in development).
- [Skuld Expenses 展會記帳](https://angiehu.com/tools/hucreates-expense/): per-event P&L app for trade shows — AI receipt reading, daily revenue sync, cash reconciliation at close, per-event ROI. Internal tool.
- [社群管理後台 Social Console](https://angiehu.com/tools/social-console/): multi-brand social media console — cross-post to FB/IG/Threads/X/TikTok/YouTube, scheduling, approval workflow, AI writing & reply drafts, audience analytics. In development.
- [擲筊 Poe Divination](https://angiehu.com/tools/poe-divination/): 3D web jiaobei (moon-block) divination — shake your phone or tap, physics-simulated blocks tumble and land as 聖筊/笑筊/陰筊/立筊. Free, no login, works in the browser at https://poe.angiehu.com (64-hexagram module in the works).
- [hu-meet 會議預約系統 Meeting Scheduler](https://angiehu.com/tools/hu-meet/): in-house Calendly replacement — one link with multiple durations and non-round-hour slots, time-zone aware, AI meeting notes. Internal team tool.
- [合約比對審閱器 Contract Diff](https://angiehu.com/tools/contract-diff/): side-by-side contract version comparison, fully client-side (contracts never uploaded), optional AI clause review. Internal tool.
- [LINE 群組即時翻譯 Bot Group Translation Bot](https://angiehu.com/tools/line-translate-bot/): LINE-group bot that auto-detects each message's language and translates two-way between Chinese and English/Korean/Japanese/Thai/Vietnamese; message content not stored. Internal tool.
- [Expo Studio 展位 3D 設計工具 Booth Designer](https://angiehu.com/tools/expo-3d-studio/): browser-based 3D trade-show booth designer — drag-and-drop booth modules, apply artwork to printable faces, export renders and print dimensions. Internal tool.
- [圖庫整理工具 Asset Catalog Automation](https://angiehu.com/tools/asset-preview/): Illustrator plugin that splits a full vector artwork file into numbered, editable files with a cover and preview PDF, leaving the original untouched. Internal tool.
